scripts.build:frontend: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm run build:native-bridge && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend build
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm --filter chatto-desktop build
scripts.check:frontend: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm run build:native-bridge && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend check
scripts.dev:frontend: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm run build:native-bridge && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend dev
scripts.knip:prepare: pnpm --dir apps/frontend run paraglide && pnpm --dir apps/frontend run prepare
scripts.lint:frontend: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm run build:native-bridge && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend lint
scripts.test:frontend: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm run build:native-bridge && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend exec vitest --run
scripts.test:desktop: pnpm run build:native-bridge && pnpm --filter @chatto/native-bridge test && pnpm --filter chatto-desktop test
scripts.test:desktop-smoke: pnpm run build:desktop && pnpm --filter chatto-desktop test:smoke
